Title: Upcoming billing changes to Azure Bandwidth

Body.Content:
On a rolling basis throughout September 2020, we’ll move Bandwidth to a source–destination billing model. Additionally, metering will be divided into inter-region meter IDs. As a result, your Bandwidth charges for inter-region data transfers will either remain the same or decrease. Your first 5 GB of outbound data transfers will remain free of charge and the current data volume tiers will be replaced by one flat price.

There will be no change to internet egress pricing. 

Learn more about updated pricing.
